title: Choose Billet's new look
question: Built from what z.cash and tempo.xyz do, with Zcash's real yellow, light and dark mode, icons, pictures and scroll animation. Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Shielded Ledger
options.lineage: z.cash and tempo.xyz, read as one system
options.thesis: Zcash's private side and Tempo's public side drawn as two halves of one page, joined by a single wire that is the billet id.
options.viewport: Big serif headline left on warm paper; right, an animated line-art sunburst (Zcash) wrapping a gold wax-sealed invoice card, Tempo rings orbiting it; yellow primary button 'Write an invoice'.
options.risk: Sits close to z.cash's own look; it needs the wire and the seal to read as Billet, not as a Zcash page.

raised.raise: One SVG wire runs from the Zcash note to the Tempo payment, and current travels along it as you scroll (stroke-dashoffset), lit only when that step is true.
The 'how it works' story is scroll-pinned planes: the invoice seals, the link travels, the payment lands, PAID stamps, each plane moving at its own speed.

options.label: Sealed Letter
options.thesis: Every invoice is a letter closed with a gold wax seal; scrolling breaks the seal and unfolds the invoice, then the payment re-seals it as a receipt.
options.viewport: A large sealed envelope centre stage with the headline over it; the seal cracks on scroll and the invoice slides out.
options.risk: Charming but more familiar (letters and seals are a common privacy metaphor) and says less about Tempo.

options.label: Signal Wiring
options.thesis: Two chains drawn as a neon wiring schematic on a strict grid.
options.viewport: Black grid, a lit wire from Zcash node to Tempo node.
options.case: Fuses, but reads as a music poster, not a payment tool; loses clarity and identification.
options.kept: The traveling current along one wire, lit only when the step is true.
options.risk: Cold and stylised for freelancers paying invoices.

options.label: Multiplane Dawn
options.thesis: Painted depth planes sliding at different speeds as you scroll.
options.viewport: Painted forest planes with the invoice on the nearest cel.
options.case: Pretty, but no tie to Zcash or Tempo; loses both axes.
options.kept: Scroll-linked planes moving at separate speeds for the how-it-works story.
options.risk: Needs painted assets we do not have.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.viewport: P100 index with billets as numbered rows.
options.case: Novelty over trust; loses both axes.
options.kept: Strict, scannable rows for the billets list.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean crypto payments landing: white, one brand colour, product screenshots, feature grid.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, two buttons, phone mockup of a billet on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other hackathon payments app.
